section-title.purpose: Launch, report, review, and finding headings.

label.purpose: Controls, badges, tabs, and compact metadata.

code.purpose: Source locations, line numbers, and code evidence.

motion.name: skeleton-shimmer
motion.purpose: Moves the loading sheen across skeleton content; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Starts the selected pull request review.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--true-color-blue, #0969da); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--true-color-blue, #0969da); color: var(--color-white, #fff); font: 600 14px/20px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.93); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-outline, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supports loading, refreshing, and session navigation.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color-default, #d0d7de); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--background-color-default, #fff); color: var(--text-color-default, #1f2328); font: 600 14px/20px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--background-color-muted, #f6f8fa); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-outline, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Filters findings within the inspection rail.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 30px 6px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color-default, #d0d7de); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--background-color-default, #fff); color: var(--text-color-default, #1f2328); font: 14px/20px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-outline, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Chooses local or cloud review execution.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .ds-segment { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color-default, #d0d7de); background: var(--background-color-default, #fff); color: var(--text-color-default, #1f2328); font: 14px/20px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); } .ds-segment:first-child { border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px; } .ds-segment:last-child { margin-left: -1px; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; } .ds-segment.ds-selected { position: relative; z-index: 1; border-color: var(--true-color-blue, #0969da); background: var(--background-color-muted, #f6f8fa); color: var(--true-color-blue, #0969da); font-weight: 600; } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-outline, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Severity Badge
components.description: Labels a finding's severity with redundant text and color.
components.css: .ds-severity-critical { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 1px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--true-color-red, #cf222e); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--true-color-red-muted, #ffebe9); color: var(--true-color-red, #cf222e); font: 600 12px/20px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); }

components.name: Selected Finding Tab
components.description: Marks the active finding in the vertical inspection index.
components.css: .ds-finding-tab { width: 100%; min-height: 38px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 8px; align-items: start; padding: 8px 11px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color-muted, #d8dee4); border-radius: 0; background: var(--background-color-default, #fff); color: var(--text-color-default, #1f2328); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--true-color-blue, #0969da); font: 600 12px/20px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); text-align: left; } .ds-finding-tab:hover { background: var(--background-color-muted, #f6f8fa); } .ds-finding-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-outline, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-severity-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-top: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--true-color-red, #cf222e); }

components.name: Code Evidence Pane
components.description: Frames neutral reviewed source beside a line-level proposed diff with explicit old and new line numbers.
components.css: .ds-code-pane { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-color-default, #d0d7de); background: var(--background-color-muted, #f6f8fa); color: var(--text-color-default, #1f2328); } .ds-code-pane header { min-height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color-default, #d0d7de); font: 600 14px/20px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); } .ds-code-pane pre { margin: 0; padding: 9px 0; overflow: auto; font: 12px/19px var(--font-mono, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace); } .ds-diff-removed, .ds-diff-added { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 42px 22px minmax(max-content,1fr); min-height: 19px; } .ds-diff-removed { background: var(--true-color-red-muted, #ffebe9); } .ds-diff-added { background: var(--true-color-green-muted, #dafbe1); }

narrative.overview:
Fleet Review is a dense, restrained work surface modeled on a precise inspection record rather than a decorative analytics dashboard. Native system typography, thin rules, quiet planes, and a single blue interaction accent keep attention on repository evidence and review state.

The system is deliberately flat and code-first. Severity color carries meaning in compact badges, dots, warning fields, and code washes; it never becomes atmosphere. Host-provided Copilot tokens may replace the documented fallbacks so the canvas remains visually native in light and dark environments.
keyCharacteristics: Compact controls and short, scannable labels.
Flat white and muted planes divided by one-pixel rules.
Blue reserved for action, selection, and keyboard focus.
Severity communicated redundantly through text, color, and grouping.
Monospaced locations and side-by-side reviewed/proposed code.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Semantic color identifies review evidence or state; it does not decorate neutral workspace chrome.

rules.name: The Host-Native Rule
rules.body: Prefer the host's matching color tokens when available and retain the documented palette as the fallback.

rules.name: The Shallow Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Create hierarchy with weight, spacing, and context before introducing another font size.

rules.name: The Code-Is-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for file locations and source only, never as a decorative product voice.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Grid Rule
rules.body: Keep the index narrow and give the fluid column to findings, reports, and code.

rules.name: The Narrow Stack Rule
rules.body: On small screens, preserve reading order by stacking navigation before evidence and reviewed code before the proposed fix.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with rules and tonal planes; do not introduce floating cards or ambient shadow.

rules.name: The Functional Curve Rule
rules.body: Use 6px curves for discrete controls and messages, pills for compact status, and square joins for continuous data structures.

dos: Do keep code, file location, finding copy, and traceability metadata visually dominant.
Do use one-pixel rules and subtle canvas shifts to organize dense information.
Do pair every severity color with a text label, grouping label, or explicit status.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the reduced-motion skeleton behavior.
Do let host tokens override fallbacks so the canvas follows its Copilot environment.
donts: Don't add decorative metrics, gradients, illustrations, or floating dashboard cards.
Don't use semantic colors for ordinary actions or neutral navigation.
Don't wrap source code to force it into narrow panes; stack panes and retain horizontal scrolling.
Don't introduce shadows where a rule or tonal plane already communicates structure.
